verdict.rationale: TeamViewer's pricing page lists "Auditability (audit log and API)", and its Web API is documented, so an audit log with programmatic access exists. An independent incident responder also describes analyzing TeamViewer connection logs. However, no evidence shows the log's fields (who, which device, when) or a documented export format for auditors. Missing for 10: documentation of per-connection fields (user, target device, timestamps), an explicit export function (CSV/report), and detail on retention and admin-console log viewing.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can see a log of who connected to which machine and when, exportable for audit

citations.quote: They wrote code to enumerate it at scale and analyze TeamViewer connection logs
